meta.title: With team filtering switched off, every purchase user is listed

plan.title: All purchase users listed for PR assignment

steps.note: Disable PR team filtering as required by the scenario.
Open Purchase Requisitions in the buyer portal.
Stay on the Open purchase requisitions tab.

args.goal: Search for PR-2, show its line items, tick one PR-2 line item, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, and inspect the Search a user list by scrolling to the end; verify that every purchase user is listed, including Food Buyer and Fruits Buyer, with no category filtering.

steps.note: Perform and verify the assignment-user-list behavior directly on the buyer screen.
Assert that Food Buyer appears in the assignment user list.
Assert that Fruits Buyer also appears in the assignment user list.
